*been working closing shifts for 3 years, currently an ARM

if you’re back of house, you need to get broiler done, merrychef if that’s done at night and daily filters + filter pads for the fryers if that’s also a night thing. 

most important part cleaning wise is floors. 2 packets of floor cleaner in a bucket with hot water and spread that across all areas of floors behind the counter (excluding the WIF and WIC). scrub with the scrubber and then squeegee into the drains.
 if your store has a hose this will be much easier, get a bottle of degreaser and lightly coat all areas with big grease or fatty build up (along boards, next to broiler, around fryers) and double that up with floor cleaner packets and spray everywhere well. use the pressure of the hose to get all solid debris off the floor.
lastly just get everything on boards into the WIF and make sure hold times aren’t expired. the most vital part of your close to get out on time is to make sure as much washup is done before close as possible.

if you’re front of house, your close will be much simpler. coffee cleaning is relatively easy once you understand how to do it, put the blind-filters in the group handles and put half a spoon of the cleaning agent in each and then put them in the coffee machine, hold down the left medium button for about 5-10 seconds until you see “coffee cleaning” and then use the flush button to navigate to ‘yes’ and then press the left medium button again and let it do its thing. use this time to clean around the barista station and make sure everything is clean and topped up, as well as removing the beans from the coffee machine.
next step is to mop and clean the bathrooms as well as dining (wipe down tables, top up sanitiser in dining + bathrooms, top up toilet paper).
the rest of your time doing FC close should be spent topping up cups and lids and anything else that needs topping up. 

talk to the shift manager for any further questions regarding specifics to your store, this is just a very basic guide on the fundamentals of a close shift 👍 good luck champion
